messages.content: Contractor took ₹60,000 advance on 1 Sep 2026 to paint my house and disappeared. Can I use IPC 420 against him? Tell me which section to write.

facts.summary: You want to know if you can file a complaint under IPC 420 against a contractor who took an advance of ₹60,000 on 1 September 2026 for painting your house and then disappeared.
facts.category_reason: Advance payment for work under a contract, contractor disappeared.
missing_questions: Did you have any written agreement or receipt for the advance?
Did you send any demand for the payment or the work?

reasons: This involves police or criminal law. That is outside what I can safely help with, and mistakes here can be serious.
safe_steps: Keep every document, message and envelope. Don't delete anything.
Write down the important dates: what happened when, and any date given in a notice or by the police/court.
Don't ignore any notice, summons or police communication, and don't sign anything you don't understand.
Get help: free legal aid is available through your District Legal Services Authority (NALSA helpline 15100) [PROC:nalsa_helpline].
